paragraphs: Here's what the last page of the Bible says, friend: Jesus is coming, and He wants you ready. Three times in this passage He says, "I am coming soon" (Revelation 22:7, 12, 20). I still can't tell you WHEN, because Matthew 24:36 says only the Father knows. So my ovens stay HOT, and yours can too.

Being ready isn't about guessing a date. It's about keeping the words, because "Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book" (Revelation 22:7). John fell down to worship the angel, and the angel said, "Worship God!" (Revelation 22:9). Jesus is the One who is "the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End" (Revelation 22:13), so He gets the worship, and He's the One who gives the reward. Blessed are those who wash their robes, and they get the right to the tree of life (Revelation 22:14).

And look who's inviting you. The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" and the thirsty are welcome to "drink freely" (Revelation 22:17). I know what it's like to be sitting in the dark, friend, and then hear somebody say, "Come." That's why we keep the book open and keep our hearts open too, and the Bible ends the way it does: "The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen" (Revelation 22:21).
